1.content:
## LOGS — wrong / bad logs

Shows **ERROR / FATAL / Exception / fail** lines for **all apps** (`app=All`) or one app (`app=EIP`, etc.).

Use next to Classic **App-Must-Should-Watch** (metrics/health). This board is for **log evidence**.

Tag hosts/services `app:<name>` so the filter works for any monitored app.

3.title: Wrong logs — ERROR / FATAL
3.query:
fetch logs
| filter loglevel == "ERROR" or loglevel == "FATAL" or matchesValue(status, "ERROR") or matchesValue(status, "FATAL") or matchesPhrase(content, " ERROR") or matchesPhrase(content, "FATAL")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(content, $app) or contains(toUpperCase(toString(host.name)), toUpperCase($app)) or contains(toString(dt.source_entity), $app)
| sort timestamp desc
| fields timestamp, loglevel, content, host.name, dt.source_entity
| limit 100

4.title: Wrong logs — count by host
4.query:
fetch logs
| filter loglevel == "ERROR" or loglevel == "FATAL" or matchesValue(status, "ERROR") or matchesPhrase(content, "Exception")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(content, $app) or contains(toUpperCase(toString(host.name)), toUpperCase($app))
| summarize wrong_logs = count(), by: { host.name }
| sort wrong_logs desc
| limit 30

6.title: Exception / Traceback
6.query:
fetch logs
| filter matchesPhrase(content, "Exception") or matchesPhrase(content, "exception") or matchesPhrase(content, "Traceback") or matchesPhrase(content, "FATAL") or matchesPhrase(content, "OutOfMemory")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(content, $app) or contains(toUpperCase(toString(host.name)), toUpperCase($app))
| sort timestamp desc
| fields timestamp, content, host.name, dt.source_entity
| limit 100

8.title: Wrong logs — fail / 5xx / timeout
8.query:
fetch logs
| filter matchesPhrase(content, "failed") or matchesPhrase(content, "Failed") or matchesPhrase(content, "FAILURE") or matchesPhrase(content, "5xx") or matchesPhrase(content, " 500") or matchesPhrase(content, " 502") or matchesPhrase(content, " 503") or matchesPhrase(content, "timeout") or matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(content, $app) or contains(toUpperCase(toString(host.name)), toUpperCase($app))
| sort timestamp desc
| fields timestamp, content, host.name, loglevel
| limit 100

9.title: Wrong-log volume (last window)
9.query:
fetch logs
| filter loglevel == "ERROR" or loglevel == "FATAL" or matchesPhrase(content, "Exception")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(content, $app) or contains(toUpperCase(toString(host.name)), toUpperCase($app))
| summarize wrong_log_count = count()
| fields wrong_log_count
